description: Implement Strategy pattern with parser registry to replace hardcoded switch statement, enabling extensibility without modification
approach: Replace the switch statement at line 729 with a ParserRegistry that maps parser types to strategy implementations. New parsers can be added by registering them without modifying existing code. This solution is a subset of DSC-MAINT-001 T1 but can be implemented independently.
